title: Happy alien
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="28" ry="30" fill="#66dd66"/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="16" ry="18" fill="#aaffaa"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="24" ry="22" fill="#66dd66"/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="32" rx="12" ry="10" fill="#99ee99"/>
  <!-- Left eye stalk -->
  <rect x="30" y="10" width="5" height="20" rx="2.5" fill="#55cc55"/>
  <!-- Right eye stalk -->
  <rect x="65" y="10" width="5" height="20" rx="2.5" fill="#55cc55"/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="10" r="8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="10" r="4" fill="#222244"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="8" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="10" r="8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="10" r="4" fill="#222244"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="8" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M38 44 Q50 56 62 44" stroke="#336633" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="42" r="3.5" fill="#ff99aa"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="42" r="3.5" fill="#ff99aa"/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d="M22 60 Q10 52 14 42" stroke="#55cc55" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right arm waving -->
  <path d="M78 60 Q90 48 86 38" stroke="#55cc55" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Left leg -->
  <rect x="36" y="90" width="8" height="10" rx="3" fill="#55cc55"/>
  <!-- Right leg -->
  <rect x="56" y="90" width="8" height="10" rx="3" fill="#55cc55"/>
  <!-- Antenna balls -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="10" r="2" fill="#aaffaa"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="10" r="2" fill="#aaffaa"/>
  <!-- Body spots -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="62" r="3" fill="#99ee99"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="66" r="3" fill="#99ee99"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="82" r="2.5" fill="#99ee99"/>
</svg>
